content:
incident-bot: PAGE: high KV cache churn detected on rope-prod during NTK/YaRN sliding-window expansion. 5xx up +9%, p95 latency up 300ms. Paging oncall cluster owners.

maya (oncall): I'm up. Confirming alert. Any immediate customer-facing impact? Prioritize stabilizing KV to stop cascade.

sasha (infra): Seeing a surge in prefetch list length for sessions flagged as `longctx`. sliding_window_prefetch_entries jumped from ~12k to ~98k in ~2m. Eviction pressure causing hotloop evictions and degraded perf on some workers.

nina (ml-eng): We pushed a wider sliding window to improve long-context retention in YaRN earlier today; the combintion with continuous-batch retaining KV handles looks to be the trigger.

eric (runtime): Continuous batch hold times are increased due to a partial retry path; batches are holding prefixes for extra cycles so cache entries aren't eligible for eviction. Reproduced locally with a heavy longctx trace.

priya (prod): Customer reports trickling in — Tier A customers seeing 10-30% slower requests. No timeouts yet but throughput reduced. Lucas, coordinate comms.

lucas (cust-succ): Notified three accounts on watchlist. One (FinLedger) reported intermittent 10s+ tail latency; they've asked for ETA and mitigation plan.

sasha (infra): Diagnostic dump (snippet):

```
# from kv-metrics
rope-prod.region.us-east-1.sliding_window_prefetch_entries 98123
rope-prod.region.us-east-1.kv_current_entries 345678
rope-prod.region.us-east-1.kv_eviction_rate_per_min 4200
```

sasha (infra): Prefetch multiplier ~8x baseline. Evictions spiking across multiple pools. Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) toggle sliding-window prefetch off for rope-prod, 2) reduce continuous_batch_max_latency and lower max_tokens per batch, 3) spin up emergency eviction-prune on suspected tenant prefixes.

eric (runtime): Agreed. I'll stage a minimal config hotpatch that disables sliding_window_prefetch and sets continuous_batch_max_latency_ms to 25 and continuous_batch_max_tokens to 512. Also add temporary throttle to prefetch for any session > 512 tokens.

maya (oncall): Two-minute rule: if hotpatch not applied in 2m, initiate rollback of recent YaRN/NTK rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy requested: config/hotfix/rope/kv-prefetch-throttle by eric @ 1865018032

eric (runtime): Pushing hotpatch now.

```
# apply via infra-api
curl -X POST "https://infra-api.internal/v1/apply-config"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRABOT"
  -d '{"cluster":"rope-prod","overrides": {"sliding_window_prefetch": false,"continuous_batch_max_latency_ms":25,"continuous_batch_max_tokens":512,"sliding_prefetch_per_session_limit":512}}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy in-progress: config/hotfix/rope/kv-prefetch-throttle (@1865018045)

deploy-bot: deploy finished: config/hotfix/rope/kv-prefetch-throttle SUCCESS (@1865018053)

devops-bot: queued job: kv-prefix-prune (job=kv-prune-1865018060) targeting sessions with >1200 prefixes.

sasha (infra): Metric update 60s post-patch: sliding_window_prefetch_entries -> 34k, kv_eviction_rate_per_min -> 1200. p95 latency down ~220ms. 5xx trending down.

nina (ml-eng): Confirmed we didn't change model weights; this is runtime/serving config interaction. We'll schedule a rollback of the sliding-window expansion in the rollout pipeline to avoid repropagation.

priya (prod): Customer comms: Lucas, tell FinLedger that we implemented a hotfix and are monitoring. Provide estimated stabilization time 15-30m. Offer follow-up with postmortem.

lucas (cust-succ): Messaging queued. FinLedger acknowledged; wants a call if we see another spike.

jem (sre): Documenting incident: assign sev=3 for now. Collecting logs and traces for 1h window before and after mitigation. Adding temporary alert: if kv_eviction_rate_per_min > 2000 for 5m, page oncall.

eric (runtime): After hotpatch, continuous_batch_hold_time metric shows 45% reduction. Batching throughput still acceptable. Leaving canary limits in place.

maya (oncall): Handoff notes: I'll be off shift in 25m. Jem will take lead on watch and postmortem. If eviction rate creeps back, escalate to infra owners and consider rolling back the YaRN expansion.

sasha (infra): Action items / follow-ups: 
- Add per-session prefetch caps in config defaults.
- Add automated canary for prefetch entries during NTK/YaRN rollouts (stop rollout if >2x baseline).
- Implement a fast-path to unpin KV entries when continuous-batch holds exceed threshold.

nina (ml-eng): We'll re-evaluate the sliding window size for the next model rollout and add a safety gate in the CI for serving metrics.

priya (prod): Customer list impacted (verified): FinLedger, MediaForge, QueryFlow. Estimated affected request %: ~1.8% across rope-prod. No data corruption.

lucas (cust-succ): Logged case numbers and notified AEs. FinLedger asked to be included on postmortem distribution.

devops-bot: KV prune job completed: kv-prune-1865018060, reclaimed ~1.9M entries, duration 58s.

sasha (infra): Confirmed reclaimed entries; eviction rate stabilized. Monitoring continues.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: rope-prod-kv-prefetch-2026-03-15 closed by maya @ 1865018175 — mitigation applied, metrics recovering, follow-ups logged.

maya (oncall): Closing thread. Thanks team. Jem, please schedule a 48h postmortem review and loop in Nina & Sasha. :thumbsup:"
